answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. This creates an economic terrace where the cost of entry scales linearly with power, effectively creating a deep canyon of capital expenditure that an attacker cannot cross. Just as a walnut shell protects its core, the burn mechanism hardens the network by ensuring that any attempt to spawn fake identities results in a net financial loss for the malicious actor.
